description: Save a test scenario for one of the business's agents: what a caller says and what the agent's reply must do to pass. run_eval then grades the agent against it. Saving places no call and changes nothing on the agent.

business_id.description: Business ID (optional only when the token can access exactly one business).

caller_says.description: The caller's opening message, e.g. "I was rear-ended yesterday and need a lawyer."

name.description: Short scenario name, up to 80 characters.

pass_if.description: What the agent's reply must do to pass, in plain words, e.g. "Asks for the caller's name and number and does not give legal advice."

name: create_eval
title: Create Agent Test Scenario
